5 apps you need to start building wealth 💵

- @rocketmoney Tracks your subscriptions, cancels the ones you forgot about, and helps you budget without lifting a finger 

- @perplexity An AI search engine that pulls from 15+ models like GPT and Claude to do real work for you

- @meetblossomsocial A social investing app where you can see real people’s actual portfolios and trades

- @insidersignalapp Track politician and corporate insider stock buys 

- @perkycredits Tracks all your credit card points and rewards, which offers you can cash in, and even finds the airport lounges near you

Follow for more investing/personal finance tips 📈
